messages:
tara (eng-platform): Noticed a spike in strict-validate rejects for toolhooks in the canary slice; many responses are tuple-style and falling through to degen billing. Can we triage?

dan (observability): Yep. `validation.rejects` + missing `route_id` fields. Billing pipeline attributes to default route.
tara (eng-platform): Example payload: ['ok', {'body':'done'}] vs expected {\"status\":\"ok\",\"body\":{...}}.

lee (eng-runtime): That's the old adapter tuple format. Parser rejects non-object top-level. Quick win: add a controlled coercion that transforms common tuples -> canonical object and tag events with `coercion=tuple->object`.

mira (product): But we can't silently accept everything. Propose per-route `validation.mode` (strict|soft|off) and a canary `soft` rollout. Also console needs a "validation coercions" panel with samples.

dan (observability): I can preserve `original_route_id` in validation events and add metric `validation.coercion.count{route_id, reason}`. Need a tiny change in billing ingest to honor `original_route_id`.

lee (eng-runtime): Implementation: keep `ctx.route_id` sticky across workers, coercion behind `validation.soft_coerce` flag, emit sampled redacted examples to S3 (0.5%).
tara (eng-platform): Rollout plan: 1% canary for 24h, expand if stable. Auto-rollback if `validation.coercion.count[5m] > 100 && degen_billing_delta > 7%`.

ops-bot: Deploy queued: feature/soft-coerce-canary -> staging. CI green.

dan (observability): I'll open PR to copy `original_route_id` and add the dashboard tile. Also creating derived metric to exclude soft-accepted tokens from degen billing.

mira (product): UI: let customers opt their routes out of soft mode and download redacted examples. Will mock tomorrow.

lee (eng-runtime): Adding adapter lint to warn on tuple outputs so teams fix sources.
tara (eng-platform): Thanks. Actions: dan PR for billing mapping, lee implement soft_coerce behind flag + samples, mira console copy/mocks, tara will draft canary doc. Paste any odd shape samples here.
